package targetcatalog

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maxTargetsPerRequest = 100

type Resolution struct {
	Resolved []domain.TargetRef
	Missing  []domain.TargetRef
}

type Resolve struct {
	Catalog repository.TargetCatalog
}

func (usecase Resolve) Handle(ctx context.Context, inputs []domain.TargetRef) (Resolution, error) {
	if usecase.Catalog == nil || len(inputs) == 0 || len(inputs) > maxTargetsPerRequest {
		return Resolution{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := domain.NormalizeTargetRefs(inputs)
	if err != nil {
		return Resolution{}, err
	}
	found, err := usecase.Catalog.ResolveExact(ctx, targets)
	if err != nil {
		return Resolution{}, err
	}
	foundSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(found))
	expectedSet := targetIdentitySet(targets)
	for _, ref := range found {
		normalized, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeTargetRef(ref)
		if normalizeErr != nil {
			return Resolution{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(normalized)
		if _, expected := expectedSet[identity]; !expected {
			return Resolution{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		foundSet[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := Resolution{
		Resolved: make([]domain.TargetRef, 0, len(targets)),
		Missing:  make([]domain.TargetRef, 0),
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if _, exists := foundSet[domain.TargetIdentity(target)]; exists {
			result.Resolved = append(result.Resolved, target)
		} else {
			result.Missing = append(result.Missing, target)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func targetIdentitySet(targets []domain.TargetRef) map[string]struct{} {
	result := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		result[domain.TargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	return result
}
